tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: Who VA International is, its mission, history and approach to training virtual assistants. Read-only and safe to repeat; it changes nothing.

tools.name: get_platform_overview
tools.description: How the VA International jobs platform works for virtual assistants and employers. Read-only and safe to repeat; it changes nothing.

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: All current course packages with live prices, billing periods and what each includes. Prices are in EUR. Read-only and safe to repeat; it changes nothing.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the price list, for example NL. Defaults to NL.

tools.name: get_package
tools.description: One course package by its code (see list_packages) with live prices and contents. Read-only and safe to repeat; it changes nothing.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the price list, for example NL. Defaults to NL.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Answers to common questions on courses, studying, jobs, payment and accounts. Optionally filter by a topic word. Read-only and safe to repeat; it changes nothing.

topic.description: Word or phrase to filter on, for example refund or English.

tools.name: get_contact_and_support
tools.description: How to reach VA International support, support hours and the company details. Read-only and safe to repeat; it changes nothing.

tools.name: search_site_content
tools.description: Keyword search over the company, platform, contact and FAQ text. Returns the best matches with page links. Read-only and safe to repeat; it changes nothing.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Returns the checkout page link for one package and billing period, so the person can finish and pay themselves. Nothing is bought yet: no order exists and nothing is charged until the person signs in, accepts the purchase terms and pays on Stripe. You cannot pay, accept terms or set a price, and you never see card details. The price in the reply is for information; the checkout page shows the final price. Packages are for virtual assistants: other accounts are blocked at checkout. Read-only and safe to repeat; it changes nothing.

billingPeriod.description: one_time, 3_months, 6_months or 12_months. Must be one of the offers of the package.

countryCode.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the price list, for example NL. Defaults to NL.

tools.name: request_account
tools.description: WRITE TOOL, not read-only. Asks VA International to start an account for a person, using their own email address. The person gets a confirmation email, then chooses their own password and accepts the terms. Until they confirm, no account, customer record or marketing consent exists. You never receive a password, login or token. The reply is the same for new and existing addresses. Only use this when the person asked you to. Accounts are for virtual assistants: other accounts are blocked at checkout.

email.description: The person's own email address. They must confirm by email.

marketingConsent.description: Only true if the person themselves said yes to product updates. Default false.
